description: cfd_2d_cpm_bedload_layer on the CFD mesh refinement with the bed across the patch edges: the box G 15 refines x 0.02-0.06 m of the bed region to 2.5 mm, the grid of CPM covers the whole bed (Q 85, the periodic length): its cells under the patch take the fluid of the patch as it is, the others the fluid of level 0 interpolated; its bed goes back onto the patch and level 0 (the mean of its cells under each cell), restricted under the patch
covers: cfd_amr::cpm_plans: the fluid of the finest grid at every cell of CPM, copied or interpolated (the stencils of a coarser grid)
cfd_amr::cpm_bplans, cpm_push: the bed onto the leaf cells of every grid as the mean of the cells of CPM, the restriction under the patches
Q 85: the region of the grid of CPM
